name: price-value-discovery-questions
description: Prepares a value discovery question set for one client call, with open questions on the outcome they want, what it is worth in their own numbers, the cost of doing nothing and their next-best alternative (their own AI included), plus an answer grid left blank for the client's words. Use for "run price-value-discovery-questions", "what is this worth to the client", "value discovery call", "questions before I price on value", "find out what the outcome is worth", "how do I ask about budget without asking about budget", "prep my discovery questions", part of the Pricing Under AI Pressure Pack by 90n.
